sources.title: Muse Glimmer | Meta
sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.title: muse-glimmer-30b Model by Meta | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B is a multimodal reasoning model accepting text and images, with native tool-calling and separate reasoning output.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer — Meta's 30B AI Model for Your Laptop
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer is Meta's open-weight 30B model that runs on one consumer GPU. Free on Hugging Face, agentic capable, and built for local-first AI workflows.

sources.title: meta/muse-glimmer • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B Muse Glimmer is Meta's 30B parameter open model built for local, agentic AI. It combines multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use, multimodal understanding, and failure recovery in a model designed to run on consumer hardware without requiring cloud infrastructure. Highlights Optimized for local agents: designed for autonomous workflows on high-end PCs and workstations ...
